text:
maya (product): quick sync — ACME pilot asked for more granular eval-trigger hooks + a runbook for quant fallback. can we scope for next sprint?

sam (eng): sounds reasonable. do we mean eval-triggered *alerts* (ops/metrics) or eval-triggered *policy* (auto-fallback to lower-quant model)?

maya (product): both ideally. priority 1 = customer-visible alerting & acceptance criteria. priority 2 = automated fallback, but gated.

leah (solutions): from customer side they're worried about hallucination regressions after quant. they want per-prompt eval checks and a way to opt a route into a higher-precision path.

oscar (cust-success): +1. ACME specifically said: alert for +5% drop in token-level match on their golden set. need SLA on detection window (~5m)

sam (eng): ok technically: we can run periodic evals against the customer's golden set (batch job) and stream metrics into the console. detection window depends on batch cadence — 5m is tight if we need full evals; we can do sampled quick checks in 1-2m plus full nightly jobs.

maya (product): tradeoffs: faster samples increase noise. propose: 2m quick sample (cheap, heuristic) -> immediate alert if breach; 1h full eval for confirmation and suggested rollback.

leah (solutions): that sounds pragmatic. what about actionable guidance? customers want a recommendation: revert quantization or route to overprovisioned dedicated pool.

sam (eng): we can surface a recommended action in the alert: {"severity": "high", "recommended": "route-to-higher-precision"} — implementing auto-fallback requires CD/ops gating.

maya (product): launch criteria idea: (1) alerting visible in Console + webhook, (2) baseline sampling job + golden-set config UI, (3) documented runbook steps and recommended actions, (4) canary for auto-fallback behind feature flag (manual opt-in).

oscar (cust-success): can we bundle a short onboarding doc for ACME with benchmarks and a suggested golden set size? they asked for a 10–50 prompt starter.

leah (solutions): yes we can provide a starter template. include examples for chat vs. single-turn.

sam (eng): for batching/caching recs: we should expose per-route recommended batch size and cache TTL based on latency SLOs. those recs can be generated from telemetry in 24h windows. low lift to add to Console.

maya (product): MVP edges: keep quant recommendations read-only initially (explain expected accuracy delta). only allow automated quant change in Dedicated/private after legal/ops signoff.

deploy-bot: new deploy queued: optimize-toolkit/telemetry-sampler -> staging (PR #4123)

oscar (cust-success): timeline ask from ACME: pilot ready in 3 weeks. is that feasible?

sam (eng): with scoped MVP (alerting + golden-set UI + starter doc + telemetry-based batch recs) probably yes. auto-fallback can be beta later.

maya (product): risks: noisy alerts -> ops fatigue. mitigation: require confirmation run before paging, and add a severity tiering. also we need quotas for golden-set evals to avoid cost surprises.

leah (solutions): acceptance criteria for pilot: alert triggers on simulated 6% drop using synthetic regressions, console shows webhook & recommended action, starter doc landed, and ACME signs off on the runbook.

maya (product): decision: target sprint schedule: week 1 = implement quick sampler + golden-set UI; week 2 = add alerting + webhook + recommendation surface; week 3 = docs, pilot onboarding, and canary runs.

oscar (cust-success): I'll block ACME for onboarding dates in week 3.

sam (eng): I'll put tickets in eng board with the above split. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

maya (product): ok cool. follow-ups: @leah please draft starter golden-set templates; @sam add the detection cadence options to the ticket; @oscar confirm pilot slot. i'll draft the launch checklist.

leah (solutions): will do. rough template: 12 chat turns + 20 single-turn prompts, labelled pass/fail, plus a few edge cases for hallucination.

oscar (cust-success): ACME confirmed week 3 window. they also want a demo run with their 25-prompt set in the canary.

maya (product): noted. adding to acceptance: run with ACME 25 prompts and validate alerting flow.

sam (eng): quick note on infra cost: add a soft quota flag per-customer for eval jobs. otherwise bad surprise.

maya (product): agreed. default quota 10 eval-minutes/hour, configurable.

leah (solutions): any objections to shipping the recommendations UI as an "Optimize Advisor" card in Console? less disruptive than new tab.

maya (product): no objections. keep it optional in initial rollout.

oscar (cust-success): thumbs up from ACME on advisor card approach. they like in-context recommendations. :thumbsup:

maya (product): great — next steps captured. anyone want to add a risk we missed?

sam (eng): dependency: need model-ops to expose per-route token metrics. pinging them in the ticket.

leah (solutions): potential UX risk: customers may misinterpret recommended actions as guarantees. add copy that clarifies it's heuristic guidance.

maya (product): yes add clear microcopy and links to docs. closing thread unless new blockers.

oscar (cust-success): thanks all.

maya (product): thanks!
